programme.title: Shameless / Shameless
programme.desc: Frank Gallagher lives together with his six children as a single father. However, he spends most of the time in the bar and gives the little money to the family, instead of eating for alcohol for food. His oldest daughter Fiona is inevitably overturning the mother role for her siblings: the intelligent but petty criminal lip, Ian, who hides his homosexuality, the responsible but fragile debbie, the 10-year violent Carl and the little Liam. Together, despite their impossible father, the children try to master their lives on creative, scandalosis, but also warmly. / Frank Gallagher lebt als alleinerziehender Vater mit seinen sechs Kindern zusammen. Allerdings verbringt er die meiste Zeit in der Bar und gibt das wenige Geld, das der Familie zur Verfugung steht, statt fur Essen lieber fur Alkohol aus. Seine alteste Tochter Fiona ubernimmt notgedrungen die Mutterrolle fur ihre Geschwister: den intelligenten aber kleinkriminellen Lip, Ian, der seine Homosexualitat verbirgt, die verantwortungsbewusste aber fragile Debbie, den 10-jahrigen gewalttatigen Carl und den kleinen Liam. Gemeinsam versuchen die Kinder, trotz ihres unmoglichen Vaters ihr Leben auf kreative, skandalose, aber auch warmherzige Weise zu meistern.

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk und die entfuhrte GroSSmutter
programme.desc: The criminal officer Adrian Monk quickly became a little bit of a small body due to his special facilities in his profession. He has a photographic memory and can make a track even from the smallest indications. Since the death of his beloved wife Trudy due to a mysterious attack, however, he has suffered from strong fears and obsessive -he -forcendants, which leads to his suspension from service at the San Fransisco Police Department. After he has locked himself up in his apartment for three years, he finally becomes a self -timed as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming Lost Monk, the crime trap that nobody else can loose. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to drive a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police service. From then on he is investigating with Commissioner Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: Smart10 - the quiz with the ten possibilities / Smart10 - Das Quiz mit den zehn Moglichkeiten
programme.desc: Two teams of two compete against each other in the knowledge duel at Caroline Athanasiadis. The participants have to demonstrate general knowledge, good teamwork, tactics and risk giving away in order to successfully cut off. / Zwei Zweierteams treten im Wissensduell bei Caroline Athanasiadis gegeneinander an. Dabei mussen die Teilnehmer Allgemeinwissen, gutes Teamwork, Taktik und Risikoeinschatzung unter Beweis stellen, um erfolgreich abzuschneiden.

programme.title: Q1 A note is wrong / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First the topic of the term searched is announced. With the help of four notes, the candidates should get on the right track - but only three of them are correct. / Bei diesem Quiz dreht sich alles um Hinweise. Zuerst wird das Thema des gesuchten Begriffes bekannt gegeben. Mithilfe von vier Hinweisen sollen die Kandidaten auf die richtige Spur kommen - doch nur drei davon sind richtig.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.desc: A cruel violent crime is done on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. In order to clear it up, the London investigator Richard Poole is put on the case. The meticulous suit runner succeeds in loosening the case together with his colleagues on site. They absolutely want to keep him in the Caribbean. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. programme.title: SOKO Kitzbuhel / SOKO Kitzbuhel
programme.desc: The Tyrolean Unterland with its outstanding sporting and tourist offers is the scene of the police team around criminal officer Karin Kofler and her colleague Lukas Roither, which specializes in criminal psychology, who, with a lot of expertise and empathy, put the craft from the local criminals. The investigators are understood by Karin's father Hannes, who runs the legendary inn "Pochlarner Stuben", and is blessed with a similar criminalistic sense of gaze. And finally there is Grafin Schonberg, who, with her contacts to the Kitzbuheler JetSet, proves again and again as valuable help for the officials. / Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - Serbian League / Košarka - Srpska liga
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Another death is added to the investigation. But whether it is a suicide or an accident, they do not know. They allow an overdose that made the boy drowned. But he was a swimmer. There were antidepressants and a cure for hallucinations in his blood. The family refuses an autopsy. Natalie and Guy believe that Tom has escaped because of the three who were in the hallway one is dead, she is forever in a stroller, only he remains. His mother is desperate and regrets that she was blind to his depression, anxiety and loneliness. Miri goes to the hospital. They talk to Davidi, who regrets that he was not with her. She is not angry, but states that he will always be the baby's father, even if he is not ready or does not like it. Miraculously, police were at school when Tom died. Someone entered the Hanoch's office and he is convinced that he is David for revengeing him. The investigator tells him that he knows he has hidden that Ido has committed suicide. Hanoch justifies that another family is involved. / Към разследването се прибавя още една смърт. Но дали е самоубийство или инцидент, не знаят. Допускат свръхдоза, заради която момчето се е удавило. Но той е бил плувец. В кръвта му е имало антидепресанти и лекарство срещу халюцинации. Семейството отказва аутопсия. Натали и Гай смятат, че Том се е измъкнал, защото от тримата, които са били в коридора единият е мъртъв, тя е завинаги в количка, остава само той. Неговата майка е отчаяна и съжалява, че е била сляпа за депресията му, тревогата и самотата. Мири постъпва в болница. Разговарят с Давиди, който съжалява, че не е бил с нея. Тя не се сърди, но заявява, че той винаги ще бъде баща на бебето, дори да не е готов или да не му харесва. По чудо полицията е била в училището, когато Том е умрял. Някой е влизал в кабинета на Ханох и той е убеден, че е Давиди, че му отмъщава. Следователят му казва, че знае, че е скрил, че Идо се е самоубил. Ханох се оправдава, че е замесено и друго семейство.

The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Land / Проект "Земя"

Екипът търси по-бързи и ефективни начини за залесяване.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Boncho Genchev / Зала на славата: Бончо Генчев
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Davidi officially accuses Eran of killing 5 children and arrested him. He thinks he wanted to take revenge on Ido's death. The inspector tells him of the first three killed children, about entering the tunnel, about dressing up, about printed pistols, but there is one question. What happened there, down, and why Dor Oon killed. The interrogation lasts for a long time, but Eran denies everything. He states that he will not speak anymore without his father, the mayor. But Davidi realizes that they are planning something and Eran follows his watch. Immediately they have to find the video operator. In the rubber, the inspector realizes that this is the girl Libby. Police are looking for her immediately, finding that her parents have been in Kenya for two months. They follow Itar's phone, it turns out to be in the school. They are all there at a mask ball and they will kill Libby. Rousseau wants to take her out. The last action begins. Miri gives birth. / Давиди официално обвинява Еран в убийството на 5 деца и го арестува. Смята, че е искал да си отмъсти за смъртта на Идо. Инспекторът му разказва за първите три убити деца, за влизането в тунела, за преобличането, за принтираните пистолети, но има един въпрос. Какво се е случило там, долу, и защо е убил Дор Орон. Разпитът продължава дълго, но Еран отрича всичко. Заявява, че няма да говори повече без баща си, кмета. Но Давиди разбира, че планират нещо и Еран следи часовника си. Веднага гтрябва да открият оператора на видеото. По гуменките инспекторът разбира, че това е момичето Либи. Полицията веднага я търси, установява, че родителите й от два месеца са в Кения. Wehen - Bayern, Football, German Cup / Wehen - Bayern, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cups dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Benfica - Fenerbahce, Football, Champions League Qualifications / Benfica - Fenerbahce, Nogomet, Kvalifikacije za Ligu prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League Qualification - (Sport. Program) The most respected European football competition, Champions League, with the group stage of the competition begins in September. After the summer break clubs that have won the qualifications through the national leagues in qualifying for the fight for places in European competitions. The Champions League qualifications consist of pre -qualification, two qualifying rounds and the final playoffs to enter the competition. The qualifying cycle begins on July 8, 2025 and ends on August 27, 2025 ... / UEFA Champions League Qualification - (sport. program) Najcjenjenije europsko nogometno natjecanje, Liga prvaka, s grupnom fazom natjecanja počinje u rujnu. Nakon ljetnog predaha klubovi koji su kroz nacionalne lige izborili plasman u kvalifikacije kreću u borbu za mjesta u europskim natjecanjima. Kvalifikacije za Ligu prvaka sastoje se od predkvalifikacija, dvije kvalifikacijske runde te završnog playoffa za ulazak u natjecanje. Kvalifikacijski ciklus počinje 8. srpnja 2025., a završava 27. kolovoza 2025. godine...

programme.title: Football - Italian League / Nogomet - Talijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian Serie A: Highlights - (Sport. Program, Italy) Serie A is a professional football competition that has 20 teams in the two -round league championship. Since 1929, when it was founded, Serie A became synonymous with tactical football. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Druga faza kvalifikacija uključuje najbolje europske reprezentativne timove te pobjednike skupina prve faze. Prva dva mjesta u svakoj grupi u drugoj fazi donose plasman na završni turnir. programme.desc: Handball - EHF European Championship Qualifiers - (Sport. Program) The performance in the final tournament of the best Teams of the Old Continent have all European national teams except the hosts and the last European champion. So the qualifications offer numerous interesting and tense matches through two qualifications phases. In the first phase, there are teams that have a lower ranking and are arranged in groups of four teams where only the winner passes in the next phase. The second phase of qualification includes the best European representative teams and the winners of the group first phase. The first two places in each group in the second phase are made by placement to the final tournament. Other positions are divided among the best-placed third teams from the group ... / Handball - EHF European Championship Qualifiers - (sport. program) Nastup u kvalifikacijama za završni turnir najboljih momčadi starog kontinenta imaju sve europske reprezentacije osim domaćina i posljednjeg europskog prvaka. Tako da kvalifikacije nude brojne zanimljive i napete utakmice kroz dvije kvalifikacijske faze. U prvoj fazi se nalaze momčadi koje imaju niži ranking te su raspoređene u skupine po četiri ekipe gdje samo pobjednik prolazi u narednu fazu. Druga faza kvalifikacija uključuje najbolje europske reprezentativne timove te pobjednike skupina prve faze. Prva dva mjesta u svakoj grupi u drugoj fazi donose plasman na završni turnir. Ostale pozicije se dijele među najbolje plasiranim trećim ekipama iz skupina...

programme.title: In all friendship / In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Dr. Kathrin Globisch's former classmate and secret swarm David Schrader is in the clinic. He wants to get a second opinion from Kathrin. After a spine's surgery, he has severe pain and is said to be operated on a second time. However, it is difficult for Kathrin to find a neutral doctor-patient relationship to David, because as it turns out, David also secretly swept for her. As a leg ambient, it fits almost perfectly into a new research profile of the space company with which he wants to fly into space. His impatience immediately wakes up again. But he gets a dramatic steamer because a dangerous abscess on the amputation wound has formed. / Dr. Kathrin Globischs ehemaliger Klassenkamerad und heimlicher Schwarm David Schrader ist in der Klinik. Er will von Kathrin eine zweite Meinung einholen. Nach einer Wirbelsaulen-OP hat er starke Schmerzen und soll ein zweites Mal operiert werden. Allerdings fallt es Kathrin schwer, ein neutrales Arzt-Patienten-Verhaltnis zu David zu finden, denn wie sich herausstellt, hat auch David heimlich fur sie geschwarmt.Der angehende Astronaut Adam Birken kann neue Hoffnung schopfen. Als Beinamputierter passt er nahezu perfekt in ein neues Forschungsprofil des Raumfahrtunternehmens, mit dem er ins All fliegen will. Sofort wachst seine Ungeduld wieder. Doch er bekommt einen dramatischen Dampfer, da sich ein gefahrlicher Abszess an der Amputationswunde gebildet hat.

programme.title: Soldier No. 1 - The General and the turn of the times / Soldat Nr. 1 - Der General und die Zeitenwende
programme.desc: The fact that Russia is preparing for a big conflict with NATO has been heard again and again for months. Carsten Breuer, General Inspector of the Bundeswehr, is the top soldier in Germany, probably the most impressive reminder: In a few years, he says, Russia is ready for a military conflict with the West. How does the Bundeswehr arise against this possible threat? What role does the general inspector play? The ARD journalist Willem Konrad and Lucas Stratmann has succeeded in accompanying Carsten Breuer with her camera for over nine months-for a conversation with Federal President Frank-Walter Steinmeier (SPD), while traveling to the Sudlibanon, Ukraine and the USA. The result is a portrait of the federal government's highest military advisor with deep insights into the German security apparatus. Carsten Breuer redefines the role of the general inspector of the interface between military and politics. Unlike his events, he is looking for the public to place his messages: in detailed newspaper interviews, in talk shows, in a conversation with burgers. Bundeswehr and society had to be warming, a term that comes from his pen and is often quoted, because of this? In Germany, Horbar will be long voices, which are concerned about an escalation with Russia and who have a skepticism in Germany. How does Breuer evaluate the criticism and the desire for more diplomatic means? The Bundeswehr rehearses the defense case in Lithuania in the NATO network. By 2027, a German brigade is to grow to a good 5000 soldiers - to deterrent against Russia. In mid -May, General Breuer will receive a military briefing over the current enemy and inspects the militaries from the hatch of the Guardian tank Puma. The exercise is suddenly interrupted, militar radio is parked. A Russian clearing aircraft was apparently seen in the airspace over the exercise. Intermediate trap like this has been in the past few months. Cyber ​​attacks, sabotage to military facilities, destroyed submarines and drone superfluge - all of this is Putin's tests to test defense and resilience, says Breuer. Because from the Russian perspective there is a long war with the West. The "Ard Story" accompanies a man who has so far had to prepare the Bundeswehr for possible seriousness almost unnoticed by the public. Who is the man who depends on so much and what role does he play for Germany? / Dass Russland sich auf einen groSSen Konflikt mit der NATO vorbereitet, ist seit Monaten immer wieder zu horen. Carsten Breuer, Generalinspekteur der Bundeswehr, ist als oberster Soldat Deutschlands der wohl eindrucklichste Mahner: Bereits in wenigen Jahren, so sagt er, sei Russland bereit fur einen militarischen Konflikt mit dem Westen. Wie stellt sich die Bundeswehr gegen diese mogliche Bedrohung auf? Welche Rolle spielt dabei der Generalinspekteur?Den ARD-Journalisten Willem Konrad und Lucas Stratmann ist es gelungen, Carsten Breuer uber neun Monate exklusiv mit ihrer Kamera zu begleiten - zum Gesprach mit Bundesprasident Frank-Walter Steinmeier (SPD), auf Reisen in den Sudlibanon, die Ukraine und die USA. Entstanden ist ein Portrat des obersten militarischen Beraters der Bundesregierung mit tiefen Einblicken in den deutschen Sicherheitsapparat.An der Schnittstelle zwischen Militar und Politik definiert Carsten Breuer die Rolle des Generalinspekteurs neu. Anders als seine Vorganger sucht er die Öffentlichkeit, um seine Botschaften zu platzieren: in ausfuhrlichen Zeitungsinterviews, in Talkshows, im Gesprach mit Burgern. Bundeswehr und Gesellschaft mussten kriegstuchtig werden, ein Begriff, der mit aus seiner Feder stammt und oft zitiert wird.Doch gehen da alle mit? In Deutschland werden langst Stimmen horbar, die sich vor einer Eskalation mit Russland sorgen und die Aufrustung in Deutschland mit Skepsis beaugen. Wie bewertet Breuer die Kritik und den Wunsch nach mehr diplomatischen Mitteln?Wahrenddessen probt die Bundeswehr im NATO-Verbund den Verteidigungsfall in Litauen. Bis 2027 soll dort eine deutsche Brigade auf gut 5000 Soldatinnen und Soldaten anwachsen - zur Abschreckung gegen Russland.Im Brigade-Quartier in Vilnius bekommt General Breuer dort Mitte Mai ein militarisches Briefing uber die aktuelle Feindlage und inspiziert die Militarubung aus der Luke des Schutzenpanzers Puma heraus. Plotzlich wird die Übung unterbrochen, der Militarfunk abgestellt. Ein russisches Aufklarungsflugzeug wurde offenbar im Luftraum uber der Übung gesichtet. Zwischenfalle wie dieser haufen sich in den letzten Monaten. Cyberangriffe, Sabotage an Militareinrichtungen, zerstorte Unterseekabel und Drohnenuberfluge - das alles seien Putins Tests, um Verteidigungsfahigkeit und Resilienz zu testen, so Breuer. Denn aus russischer Sicht herrsche langst Krieg mit dem Westen.Die "ARD Story" begleitet einen Mann, der bislang fast unbemerkt von der Öffentlichkeit eher im Hintergrund die Bundeswehr fur mogliche Ernstfalle vorbereiten muss. Wer ist der Mann, von dem so viel abhangt, und welche Rolle spielt er fur Deutschland?

programme.title: Real life / Echtes Leben
programme.desc: The film has the story of Claudia Finke. Your life will be turned upside down in September 2023. Husband Uwe Korous get the diagnosis as. The incurable nervous disease is progressing quickly. For Claudia this is a great emotional challenge. Despite the rapid deterioration of his condition, Uwe decides to actively shape his remaining time. He still wants to realize dreams, for example with the paraglider over the Tyrolean mountains. Claudia is always by his side and supports him, with everything he was up to. When Uwe Spurt that his life at home is no longer worth living, he goes to the hospice. There he says goodbye, and Claudia is with him, until the end. The film shows how both deal with the incurable disease, such as Claudia Uwes decision to determine his end himself, how she can cope with the loss and live on after his death. / Der Film erzahlt die Geschichte von Claudia Finke. Ihr Leben wird im September 2023 auf den Kopf gestellt. Ehemann Uwe Korous erhalt die Diagnose ALS. Die unheilbare Nervenkrankheit schreitet bei ihm schnell voran. Fur Claudia ist das eine groSSe emotionale Herausforderung. Trotz der rasanten Verschlechterung seines Zustands, entscheidet Uwe, seine verbleibende Zeit aktiv zu gestalten. Er will noch Traume verwirklichen, etwa mit dem Gleitschirm uber die Tiroler Berge fliegen. Claudia ist immer an seiner Seite und unterstutzt ihn, bei allem, was er vorhat. Als Uwe spurt, dass sein Leben zu Hause nicht mehr lebenswert ist, geht er ins Hospiz. Dort nimmt er Abschied, und Claudia ist bei ihm, bis zuletzt.Der Film zeigt, wie beide mit der unheilbaren Krankheit umgehen, wie Claudia Uwes Entscheidung, uber sein Ende selbst zu bestimmen, mittragt, wie sie mit dem Verlust klarkommt und nach seinem Tod weiterlebt.

programme.title: Veterinary doctor Dr. Mertens / Tierarztin Dr. Mertens
programme.desc: Jasper assumes that the head animal doctor is abuse of medication. That's why he tries to focus on Susanne. But Susanne doesn't want to be put about Jasper's spy. Nevertheless, it cannot be prevented from taking a closer look. Nevertheless, the collaboration between her and the ELIF is developing increasingly positively. Together, the doctors prevent an epidemic emergency. Susanne avoids contact with Mike Redmann. She feels her evening together as a betrayal of Christoph and misses her husband all the more. But even if she banishes the thoughts of Mike, she is not doing well with it. When Mikes cousin Bernd asked her on the construction site on Mike, she reacts Uber. Georg realizes this and asks. But Susanne doesn't tell her father how it is really about her. Susanne and her daughter Luisa are long in. However, Susanne still doesn't know that Luisa is responsible for the tetanus disease of the Giraffe bull Alpay. Luisa can't tell her. She does not want to stress and didn't want to burden Susanne anymore. She lacks exactly that - to be able to talk about everything with her mother. Susanne doesn't seem to worry about her son Jonas. Because it hovers with Gina in the seventh heaven. But clouds are raising - Gina's brother Justin is again at the same time building crap. And there is also trouble between Jonas and his sister Luisa, who finally discharges in a violent argument. Jonas wants Luisa to finally take responsibility for her mistake with the giraffe bull. Susanne, who has not noticed the reason for the dispute, introduces himself on Luisa's side and accuses Jona's excitement. All three differ in the dispute. In the end, Jonas also arrested Justin - which Gina looks at. / Jasper unterstellt der Cheftierarztin Medikamentenmissbrauch. Deshalb versucht er, Susanne auf sie anzusetzen. Doch Susanne will sich nicht zu Jaspers Spitzel machen lassen. Trotzdem lasst sich nicht verhindern, dass sie nun etwas genauer hinsieht. Dennoch entwickelt sich die Zusammenarbeit zwischen ihr und Elif zunehmend positiv. Gemeinsam verhindern die Ärztinnen eine epidemische Notlage. Susanne meidet den Kontakt zu Mike Redmann. Ihren gemeinsamen Abend empfindet sie als Verrat an Christoph und vermisst ihren Mann umso mehr. Aber auch wenn sie die Gedanken an Mike verbannt, es geht ihr nicht gut damit. Als Mikes Cousin Bernd sie auf der Baustelle auf Mike anspricht, reagiert sie uber. Georg realisiert das und fragt nach. Aber Susanne sagt ihrem Vater nicht, wie es wirklich um sie steht.Langsam nahern sich Susanne und ihre Tochter Luisa an. Allerdings weiSS Susanne noch immer nicht, dass Luisa fur die Tetanuserkrankung des Giraffenbullen Alpay verantwortlich ist. Luisa kann es ihr nicht sagen. Sie will keinen Stress und mochte Susanne nicht noch mehr belasten. Dabei fehlt ihr doch genau das - mit ihrer Mutter uber alles reden zu konnen. Um ihren Sohn Jonas scheint sich Susanne keine Sorgen machen zu mussen. Denn der schwebt mit Gina im siebten Himmel. Aber es ziehen Wolken auf - Ginas Bruder Justin ist schon wieder dabei, Mist zu bauen. Und auch zwischen Jonas und seiner Schwester Luisa gibt es Ärger, der sich schlieSSlich in einem heftigen Streit entladt. Jonas will, dass Luisa endlich Verantwortung fur ihren Fehler mit dem Giraffenbullen ubernimmt. Susanne, die den Grund fur den Streit nicht mitbekommen hat, stellt sich auf Luisas Seite und wirft Jonas Übergriffigkeit vor. Alle drei gehen im Streit auseinander. Am Ende verhaftet Jonas auch noch Justin - was Gina entsetzt mit ansieht.

programme.title: Hubert and Staller / Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: Hubert and Staller find a saddled but riderless horse on the side of the road. programme.title: For always in the heart / Fur immer im Herzen
programme.desc: The attractive publishing manager Julia Berger (Natalia Worner) apparently has everything you can wish for: a responsible profession, a likeable friend, a chic apartment and a racy sports car. However, what she doesn't have is a private life. This gets both her long-term friend Fred (Horst-Gunter Marx) traces and her family, whom she has hardly any contact. Only for her ten -year -old nephew Stefan (Patrick Baehr) Julia has a very close relationship. It is all the more shocked when one day it turns out that Stefan has a severe form of bone cancer. However, it doesn't take long for the mentally unstable Isabell to no longer grow to emotional pressure. After a nervous break, she is looking for help in a clinic. However, her professional career suffers from this. Julia will soon be presented to the publisher before choosing: does she continue to take out her fuid position or increasingly devote herself to her private environment? For the first time, self -confident Julia threatens to lose control over her life. When she gets little later with her sister, at the same time saves an important merger wife of her publisher, and little Stefan is released from the hospital with good forecasts, everything seems to be turning. But just when Julia full of self -confidence discusses her further career with her CEO, the news arrives that Stefan's condition has suddenly deteriorated. / Die attraktive Verlagsleiterin Julia Berger (Natalia Worner) hat scheinbar alles, was man sich nur wunschen kann: einen verantwortungsvollen Beruf, einen sympathischen Freund, eine schicke Wohnung und einen rassigen Sportwagen. Was sie jedoch nicht hat, ist ein Privatleben. Das bekommt sowohl ihr Dauerfreund Fred (Horst-Gunter Marx) zu spuren als auch ihre Familie, zu der sie kaum noch Kontakt hat. Das Verhaltnis zu ihrem Vater Richard (Hanns Zischler) ist sehr distanziert, und ihre jungere Schwester Isabell (Julia Jager) leidet darunter, nie einen beruflichen Erfolg wie Julia erlangt zu haben. Einzig zu ihrem zehnjahrigen Neffen Stefan (Patrick Baehr) hat Julia ein sehr enges Verhaltnis. Umso schockierter ist sie, als sich eines Tages herausstellt, dass Stefan an einer schweren Form von Knochenkrebs erkrankt ist. Der Junge wird in eine Kinderklinik eingewiesen, wo sich der behandelnde Arzt Dr. Boppard (Hannes Jaenicke) mit viel Einfuhlungsvermogen sowohl der Kinder als auch der Angehorigen annimmt. Es dauert jedoch nicht lange, bis die psychisch labile Isabell dem emotionalen Druck nicht mehr gewachsen ist. Nach einem Nervenzusammenbruch sucht sie auf Julias Drangen Hilfe in einer Klinik.Nun steht Julia vor der schweren Aufgabe, dem kranken, von der Chemotherapie gezeichneten Stefan ganz alleine beizustehen. Darunter leidet jedoch ihre berufliche Karriere. Schon bald wird Julia im Verlag vor die Wahl gestellt: Will sie weiterhin ihre Fuhrungsposition ausuben oder sich zunehmend ihrem privaten Umfeld widmen? Zum ersten Mal droht die selbstbewusste Julia die Kontrolle uber ihr Leben zu verlieren. Als sie wenig spater mit ihrer Schwester ins Reine kommt, zugleich ein wichtiges Fusionsgeschaft ihres Verlages rettet, und der kleine Stefan mit guten Prognosen aus dem Krankenhaus entlassen wird, scheint sich endlich alles zum Guten zu wenden. Aber gerade als Julia voller Selbstsicherheit mit ihren Vorstandschefs uber ihre weitere Karriere diskutiert, trifft die Nachricht ein, dass Stefans Zustand sich schlagartig verschlechtert hat.

programme.desc: The private cleaning lady of district manager Girwidz Kerstin Wilm is intended to bring the police station to the fore for a press appointment. Aber obwohl Hubert ein Verhaltnis zwischen Girwidz und Kerstin Wilm ausschlieSSt, so ist es doch Girwidz Verbindung zu seiner Putzfrau, die zur Losung des Falles fuhrt.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: The 22-year Pascal Munchhoff is found dead in a remote forest stuck. His head injury indicates that he was killed. Initial investigations show that Munchhoff was furrowed as a "bully", together with his brother he harassed the neighbors in the high -rise block and granted them gricest and mental violence. The commissioners find that Munchhoff was not imposed, tied up and beaten at the site in the forest, but in the basement of his house. Has one of the numerous victims fight against his tormentor? The Schuchtern was suspected 18-year-old Schuler Lukas Berger, to whom Munchhoff has made life a holl for years. But the Pia Stern of the same age also had a motive for a crime, because Munchhoff sexually affected it for years. Or is there even a connection between the two suspects? / Der 22-jahrige Pascal Munchhoff wird tot in einem abgelegenen Waldstuck aufgefunden. Seine Kopfverletzung deutet darauf hin, dass er erschlagen wurde. Erste Ermittlungen ergeben, dass Munchhoff als "Bully" gefurchtet war, gemeinsam mit seinem Bruder schikanierte er die Nachbarn im Hochhausblock und fugte ihnen korperliche und seelische Gewalt zu. Die Kommissare finden heraus, dass Munchhoff nicht am Fundort im Wald, sondern im Keller seines Wohnhauses uberwaltigt, gefesselt und geschlagen wurde. programme.sub-title: 1.100 Jahre Heiliger Wolfgang - Menschen und Legenden am Wolfgangsee
programme.desc: For over 1000 years, people from all over the world have had a pilgrimage to the Wolfgangsee to follow the traces of St. Wolfgang and drink on his healing source or to drop "miracle water". They admire his church in St. Wolfgang with the based Michael Pacher -Altar - he shows the wolf legend - and ask for buses and healing. The pilgrimage passed the culture and economy of the region around the Abersee, as the Wolfgangsee originated originally. Gastricifications, breweries, gingerbread manufacturers, drives and glass huts already developed at the time, because the pilgrims wanted to be cared for, just like the numerous tourists from today. / Seit uber 1000 Jahren pilgern Menschen aus aller Welt an den Wolfgangsee, um den Spuren des Heiligen Wolfgang zu folgen und an seiner Heilquelle zu trinken oder "Wunderwasser" abzufullen. Sie bewundern seine Kirche in St. Wolfgang mit dem beruhmten Michael Pacher-Altar - er zeigt die Wolfganglegende - und bitten um BuSSe und Heilung.Die Pilgerfahrt pragte die Kultur und Wirtschaft der Region rund um den Abersee, wie der Wolfgangsee ursprunglich geheiSSen hat. Gastwirtschaften, Brauereien, Lebkuchenherstellern, Fahrbetrieben und Glashutten entwickelten sich bereits damals, denn die Pilgerreisenden wollten versorgt sein, genauso wie die zahlreichen Touristinnen und Touristen von heute.Peter Beringer begibt sich auf eine spannende Spurensuche nach dem Heiligen Wolfgang und seiner Wirkung auf die Menschen und die Landschaft.

programme.title: The taste of Europe / Der Geschmack Europas
programme.desc: This time Lojze Wieser and Florian Gebauer are looking for the taste of Europe on the British Islands, more precisely after Wales. In the country of myths and legends, the Welsh language is still widespread and flags with the legendary red kite crowns are the historical fortresses and castles, of which there are more than 600 in number than in any other country in Europe. These are not only the remains of history but also proof of Wales Wild past. On the trip, Lojze Wieser costs itself through the typical-Welsh taste of Laverbread, Heart Mussels, Bara Brith or the typical Fish and Chips and meets people who can transfer the old recipes to today. / Diesmal verschlagt es Lojze Wieser und Florian Gebauer auf der Suche nach dem Geschmack Europas auf die Britischen Inseln, genauer gesagt nach Wales.Im Land der Mythen und Legenden ist die walisische Sprache noch weit verbreitet und Flaggen mit dem legendaren roten Drachen kronen die historischen Festungen und Burgen, von denen es in Wales mehr als 600 an der Zahl gibt und damit mehr als in jedem anderen Land Europas. Diese sind nicht nur Überreste der Geschichte sondern auch ein Beweis fur Wales wilde Vergangenheit.Auf der Reise kostet sich Lojze Wieser durch die typisch-walisischen Geschmacker von Laverbread, Herzmuscheln, Bara Brith oder den typischen Fish and Chips und trifft auf Menschen, die die alten Rezepte ins Heute ubertragen konnen.

programme.title: Netanyahu - The indictment of the International Criminal Court / Netanjahu - Die Anklage des Internationalen Strafgerichtshofs
programme.desc: Since November 2024, an arrest warrant from the ISTGH International Criminal Court against Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu and his then Defense Minister Yoav Galant. The destruction of entire residential areas with countless civilian fatalities, the destruction of agricultural flats and parts of water supply, the disability of humanitarian aid and attacks on the medical infrastructure are meticulously demonstrated by the analysis of satellite images. Der Haftbefehl gegen Netanjahu ist der erste wegen Kriegsverbrechen gegen den Staatschef eines vom Westen unterstutzten demokratischen Landes.Das WELTjournal zeigt, worauf sich die Anschuldigungen des IStGH gegen Netanjahu und Galant stutzen. Die Zerstorung ganzer Wohnviertel mit zahllosen zivilen Todesopfern, die Zerstorung von landwirtschaftlichen Flachen und Teilen der Wasserversorgung, die Behinderung humanitarer Hilfe sowie Angriffe auf die medizinische Infrastruktur werden u.a. durch die Analyse von Satellitenbildern akribisch nachgewiesen. programme.title: Israel's right -wing extremist minister / Israels rechtsextreme Minister
programme.desc: The two right-wing extremists Bezalel Smotrich and ITAMAR Ben-Gvir repress only a small part of Israeli society, but in the Netanyahu government they have a lot of power and have a significant contribution to radicalization of politics. They reject an end to the war in Gaza and instead demand a resettlement of the Palastinians and a possession and Israeli colonization of the Palastinian Gaza Strip. Several likers such as Canada, Australia, Great Britain, Norway and the EU country Slovenia have prevented sanctions against them. The World Journal+ shows a portrait of the two ministers who pursue a common ideological agenda: the annexation of the occupied Palastinian areas and a large Israel. At the same time, the resistance of those Israelis who have been fishing the end of democracy in their state since the Netanyahu government's judicial conversion tarpaulins have also been shown. The former Israeli ministerial prayer Ehud Barak and Ehud Olmert and the Fruher Minister of Justice Tzipi Livni, who - like many Israelis - are concerned about the national religious and right -wing power in politics: Jerôme Sesquin / Die beiden rechtsextremen Minister Bezalel Smotrich und Itamar Ben-Gvir reprasentieren nur einen kleinen Teil der israelischen Gesellschaft, doch in der Regierung Netanjahu haben sie uberproportional viel Macht und tragen maSSgeblich zur Radikalisierung der Politik bei. Ein Ende des Krieges in Gaza lehnen sie ab und fordern stattdessen eine Umsiedlung der Palastinenser und eine Besitznahme und israelische Besiedelung des palastinensischen Gazastreifens. Mehrere Lander wie Kanada, Australien, GroSSbritannien, Norwegen und das EU-Land Slowenien haben Sanktionen gegen sie verhangt.Das WELTjournal+ zeigt ein Portrat der beiden Minister, die eine gemeinsame ideologische Agenda verfolgen: die Annexion der besetzten palastinensischen Gebiete und ein GroSS-Israel. programme.title: Austrian picture from the Vienna State Studio / Österreich-Bild aus dem Landesstudio Wien
programme.sub-title: Sport statt Gewalt - Wie Wiener Vereine Jugendliche vor dem Abgrund retten
programme.desc: Reporting sport instead of violence shows how committed people in Viennese clubs try to keep children and young people on the right track with sports and prevent slipping into the criminal. Regardless of whether when boxing, football or basketball, who does sports and finds friends, may often get into stupid ideas out of boredom. The clubs go different ways. The focus is on rules, discipline and hard training in the Ottakringer Boxclub Bounce. The Kafigleague of Vienna Caritas is following a different approach. Anyone can come to the low -threshold football dates in the park. This is about reaching the children at all and building trust. Was also listen to the top of Basketballer Mohammad Yaseen and his club Basketball Plus. The plus stands for mental health and he wants to convey it about sport. The health coach, which himself has escape experience, catches up with a large number of young people - with sports and fun in basketball. A film by Barbara Lupac for the Vienna State Studio / Die Reportage Sport statt Gewalt zeigt, wie engagierte Menschen in Wiener Vereinen versuchen, Kinder und Jugendliche mit Sport auf dem richtigen Weg zu halten und ein Abrutschen ins Kriminal zu verhindern. Egal ob beim Boxen, beim Fussball oder beim Basketball, wer Sport macht und dabei Freunde findet, kommt vielleicht weniger oft aus Langeweile auf dumme Ideen.Dabei gehen die Vereine unterschiedliche Wege. Im Ottakringer Boxclub Bounce stehen Regeln, Disziplin und hartes Training im Vordergrund. Einen anderen Ansatz verfolgt die Kafigleague der Wiener Caritas. Zu den niederschwelligen Fussballterminen im Park kann jeder kommen. Hier geht es darum die Kinder uberhaupt einmal zu erreichen und Vertrauen aufzubauen. Zuhoren steht auch ganz oben bei Basketballer Mohammad Yaseen und seinem Verein Basketball Plus. Das Plus steht fur Mentale Gesundheit und die will er uber den Sport vermitteln. Der Gesundheits-Coach, der selbst Fluchterfahrung hat, fangt so eine groSSe Anzahl von Jugendlichen auf - mit Sport und SpaSS beim Basketball. Ein Film von Barbara Lupac fur das Landesstudio Wien

Gezeigt wird zugleich auch der Widerstand jener Israelis, die seit den Justiz-Umbauplanen der Netanjahu-Regierung das Ende der Demokratie in ihrem Staat befurchten. Zu Wort kommen die ehemaligen israelischen Ministerprasidenten Ehud Barak und Ehud Olmert und die fruhere Justizministerin Tzipi Livni, die - wie viele Israelis - mit Sorge auf die nationalreligiosen und rechtsextremen Stromungen in der Politik blicken.Gestaltung: Jerôme Sesquin

programme.title: The school of animals - learning from fellow species / Die Schule der Tiere - Lernen von Artgenossen
programme.desc: Not only people cooperate and act in social groups - many animal species have also learned to pass on their knowledge and experience. Whether successful hunting techniques, the search for food, recognizing and warding off dangers, or adaptation of well -preserved hiking routes due to the global warming - every species has developed fascinating methods to ensure their own survival or to learn how to make life easier. For example, the younger generation of earthmen show how scorpions are safely killed, macaks give to other and orcas have recognized that it is more convenient to steal their meal directly from the fisherman's fishing hook. This documentation accompanies animal behavior researchers around the globe, which steadily discovered surprising, highly developed animal societies and cultures. / Nicht nur Menschen kooperieren und agieren in sozialen Gruppen - auch viele Tierarten haben gelernt, ihr Wissen und ihre Erfahrung weiterzugeben. programme.desc: For over 1000 years, people from all over the world have had a pilgrimage to the Wolfgangsee to follow the traces of St. Wolfgang and drink on his healing source or to drop "miracle water". They admire his church in St. Wolfgang with the based Michael Pacher -Altar - he shows the wolf legend - and ask for buses and healing. The pilgrimage passed the culture and economy of the region around the Abersee, as the Wolfgangsee originated originally. Gastricifications, breweries, gingerbread manufacturers, drives and glass huts already developed at the time, because the pilgrims wanted to be cared for, just like the numerous tourists from today. / Seit uber 1000 Jahren pilgern Menschen aus aller Welt an den Wolfgangsee, um den Spuren des Heiligen Wolfgang zu folgen und an seiner Heilquelle zu trinken oder "Wunderwasser" abzufullen. programme.title: The taste of Europe / Der Geschmack Europas

programme.title: Netanyahu - The indictment of the International Criminal Court / Netanjahu - Die Anklage des Internationalen Strafgerichtshofs
programme.desc: Since November 2024, an arrest warrant from the ISTGH International Criminal Court against Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu and his then Defense Minister Yoav Galant. Die Zerstorung ganzer Wohnviertel mit zahllosen zivilen Todesopfern, die Zerstorung von landwirtschaftlichen Flachen und Teilen der Wasserversorgung, die Behinderung humanitarer Hilfe sowie Angriffe auf die medizinische Infrastruktur werden u.a. durch die Analyse von Satellitenbildern akribisch nachgewiesen. programme.title: Almsommer / Almsommer
programme.desc: A dairy in Styria, a Schafbauer in East Tyrol and a shepherd in Vorarlberg give an insight into a life that is characterized by the protective of the landscape and a traditional culture. She started her competitive career at the age of 11, 4 times the world champion and 3 times World Cupsemian winner. In the conversation she explains Harry the difference between the two disciplines lead and boulder and what success was for her. / Harry Prunster macht sich auf, um die Etappen 1 bis 3 des Tiroler Adlerwegs, der sich zwischen Kaisergebirge und Arlberg uber 320 km erstreckt, zu erwandern. Der Start des Weitwanderweges ist unweit des Rummlerhofes von Josef und Thomas Lackner in St. Johann. Die beiden Bruder haben den Hof vor wenigen Jahren von den Eltern ubernommen, Josef ist der Wirt und Thomas der Koch. Die Ursprunge des Hofes liegen im Jahr 1707, und im Gesprach mit Harry erzahlen beide von dessen wechselvoller Geschichte als Erbhof. Fur die Weitwanderer die von hier aus sich auf den Adlerweg machen, gibt es ein starkendes Fruhstuck und als Spezialitat gelten Ripperln und die selbstgemachten Strudel.Harry wandert vor der imposanten Kulisse des Wilden Kaiser weiter zur Gaudeamushutte von Martin und Robert Leichtfried. programme.title: Harrys liabste Huttn / Harrys liabste Huttn
programme.desc: From July 15th, Harry Prunster took a special long -distance hiking trail on nine Sundays: the Tyrolean Adlerweg. Alexandra Huber takes care of the physical well -being, prepared the floor -standing home cooking such as veal frame and spinraum sparrows. From Achensee, Harry starts the Mauritzalm. There, Gerhard Reiter grief around 155 animals, young cattle, cattle, pigs and goats. Some of them are on the alpine pasture as a loan cattle and come back to their own farm after the downforce. Juli hat sich Harry Prunster an neun Sonntagen einen besonderen Weitwanderweg vorgenommen: den Tiroler Adlerweg. programme.title: Home Austria / Heimat Österreich
programme.desc: The Tennengau and the Kleinarltal in the Salzburg region are more than just breathtaking landscapes - they are treasury of living traditions, supported by people who love their roots and at the same time look a look forward. Embedded in this region full of timeless protective narrated hidden farmers' farm from a world in which the original peasantry is lived with joy and dedication. For example on the Kurzegg Alm, where the Schiefer family lovingly renovated the alpine pasture at 1709 meters of Seehohe and bake fresh sourdough bread for the guest in their old bread oven. In St. Martin in the Tennengebirge, the mountain farm of the Leutgeb family is located at 900 meters high. Hof-Erbin Jenny Leutgeb is involved with heart and mind for the preservation of biodiversity: Haflinger horses, Krainer Steinschaffe and the rare dark bee find a home here. At the foot of the Tennen Mountains, in Kuchl, the Biobauerhof Geyerspichl is located by the Springl family. Here Sepp Springl maintains a rather unusual breed for the region: East Frisian milk sheep. In addition to agriculture, Sepp Springl is dedicated to his second passion: the carpenter. R: Alfred Ninaus / Der Tennengau und das Kleinarltal im Salzburger Land sind mehr als nur atemberaubende Landschaften - sie sind Schatzkammern lebendiger Traditionen, getragen von Menschen, die ihre Wurzeln lieben und zugleich den Blick nach vorn richten. Eingebettet in diese Region voller zeitloser Schonheit erzahlen versteckte Bauernhofe von einer Welt, in der das ursprungliche Bauerntum mit Freude und Hingabe gelebt wird. So etwa auf der Kurzegg Alm, wo Familie Schiefer auf 1709 Metern Seehohe die Almwirtschaft liebevoll saniert hat und in ihrem alten Brotbackofen frisches Sauerteigbrot fur die Gaste backen. In St. Martin im Tennengebirge liegt der Bergbauernhof der Familie Leutgeb auf 900 Metern Hohe. Hof-Erbin Jenny Leutgeb engagiert sich mit Herz und Verstand fur den Erhalt der Artenvielfalt: Haflinger Pferde, Krainer Steinschafe und die seltene Dunkle Biene finden hier ein Zuhause. Am FuSSe des Tennengebirges, in Kuchl, liegt der Biobauernhof Geyerspichl der Familie Springl. Hier pflegt Sepp Springl eine eher ungewohnliche Rasse fur die Region: ostfriesische Milchschafe. Neben der Landwirtschaft widmet sich Sepp Springl seiner zweiten Leidenschaft: dem Tischlerhandwerk. R: Alfred Ninaus

programme.title: Country life / Landleben
programme.desc: In the otherwise tranquil Kaunertal, there is great excitement every five years, because then the large district music festival with 26 chapels takes place in the grass. There are almost more musicians in the valley than people actually live there. The marquee, the moving in the chapels, the barrel tapping, the based on the greater marching competition and the state-related reception of the guardians around their captain Franz keep the locals and visitors trot. In this "country life" production, director Christian Papke accompanies people around this unique festival. While the big music festival is celebrated down in the Kaunertal, life has its own rhythm on the top of the Alm. Matthias Schnegg is hiding his cow on Nasserein-Alm, while his sister Sarah grief for the traditional costumes of the musicians and helps prepare the music festival. At the bottom of the valley, the farmers prepare the hayers and the immudent Otto Kummerts as the way responsible for paths for the road network in the Kaunertal, while Mountain Master Joe Kase-Supplement from Nasserein-Alm. / Im sonst so beschaulichen Kaunertal herrscht alle funf Jahre groSSe Aufregung, denn dann findet in der Grasse das groSSe Bezirksmusikfest mit 26 Kapellen statt. Dabei sind fast mehr Musiker im Tal, als dort eigentlich Menschen leben. Das Festzelt, der Einzug der Kapellen, der Fassanstich, der beruhmt-beruchtigte Marschierwettbewerb und der landesubliche Empfang der Schutzen rund um ihren Hauptmann Franz halten die Einheimischen und die Besucher auf Trab. Regisseur Christian Papke begleitet in dieser "Landleben"-Produktion die Menschen rund um dieses einzigartige Fest. Wahrend unten im Kaunertal das groSSe Musikfest gefeiert wird, hat das Leben oben auf der Alm seinen eigenen Rhythmus. Matthias Schnegg hutet auf der Nasserein-Alm seine Kuhe, wahrend seine Schwester Sarah sich um die Trachten der Musikanten kummert und bei der Vorbereitung des Musikfests hilft. Unten im Tal bereiten die Bauerinnen die Heuernte vor und der unermudliche Otto kummert sich als Wege-Verantwortlicher um das StraSSennetz im Kaunertal, wahrend Bergmeister Joe Kase-Nachschub von der Nasserein-Alm besorgt.

programme.title: Country life / Landleben
programme.desc: Between the Karwendel and the Dolomites, Tyrol shows himself from his perhaps most impressive side: wide thaler, snow -capped summits, bare lakes and flexible mountain meadows. Here nature has created a landscape of enchanting protective - a beautifulness in which people with traditional farmers and lively customs have organized themselves organically. Director Gerhard Amm travels to this spots Austria and shows how he has become a home for people here for generations. / Zwischen dem Karwendel und den Dolomiten zeigt sich Tirol von seiner vielleicht beeindruckendsten Seite: Weite Taler, schneebedeckte Gipfel, blanke Seen und bluhende Bergwiesen. Hier hat die Natur eine Landschaft von bezaubernder Schonheit geschaffen - eine Schonheit, in die sich die Menschen mit traditionellen Bauernhofen und lebendigem Brauchtum organisch eingefugt haben. Regisseur Gerhard Amm bereist diesen Flecken Österreich und zeigt, wie er den Menschen hier seit Generationen zur Heimat geworden ist.

programme.title: Country life / Landleben
programme.desc: The Mur is the Styrian river par excellence. He releases the history of the country along his run: a story about the change of the Mur Valley from industry to tourism, from exploitation to harmony with nature. After the decline of the region due to the crisis of the mining, the steel industry and the pollution of the Mur by the paper industry, the region is back up: the Mur has changed from a dirty sewer to the species -rich habitat. The country's landscape and cultural wealth is more likely to be in the foreground than ever: the mountains of Krakow, the Grebenzen and customs nature park such as the Samson run form the basis for gentle tourism. Even the eagle has returned to the region. The film "Das Murtal" by Alfred Ninaus is beating out of spectacular landscape shots, culture, customs and the people who are committed to the region, a colorful arc that shows the current state of the Murtal, but also the perspectives for the future. / Die Mur ist der steirische Fluss schlechthin. Er erzahlt entlang seines Laufs die Geschichte des Landes, das er durchflieSSt: eine Geschichte uber den Wandel des Murtales von der Industrie zum Tourismus, von der Ausbeutung hin zum Einklang mit der Natur. Nach dem Niedergang der Region durch die Krise des Bergbaus, der Stahlindustrie und der Verschmutzung der Mur durch die Papierindustrie ist die Region wieder im Aufwind: Die Mur hat sich von einer verschmutzten Kloake zum artenreichen Lebensraum gewandelt. Der landschaftliche und kulturelle Reichtum des Landes ruckt mehr denn je in den Vordergrund: Die Berge der Krakau, der Naturpark Grebenzen und Brauchtumsveranstaltungen wie der Samson-Lauf bilden die Basis fur einen sanften Tourismus. Selbst der Adler ist in die Region zuruckgekehrt. Der Film "Das Murtal" von Alfred Ninaus schlagt aus spektakularen Landschaftsaufnahmen, Kultur, Brauchtum und den Menschen, die die Region pragen, einen bunten Bogen, der den aktuellen Zustand des Murtals, aber auch die Perspektiven fur die Zukunft zeigt.
